description: Land Title Settlement Department - Karagampitiya, Dehiwala D/S Division, Colombo District - Cad. Map No. 520811 and others
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, including declarations of title determinations for specific land parcels, ownership details, and property rights. It contains detailed schedules of land parcels with ownership information, extents, and encumbrances, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
